events.title: ExxonMobil Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates on Higher Upstream Production
events.body: XOM beats Q1 EPS and revenue estimates on higher upstream output despite timing effects and Middle East disruptions.

events.title: Valero Q1 Earnings Top Estimates on Stronger Refining Margins
events.body: VLO's Q1 2026 EPS jumps to $4.22 as refining and renewable diesel margins surge, driving revenue beat and a sharp profitability rebound.

events.title: Phillips 66 Q1 Earnings Beat on Higher Realized Refining Margins
events.body: PSX beats Q1 earnings estimates as refining margins surge and revenues climb y/y, offsetting derivative losses that weigh on profitability.
